data.one_liner: A simple text formatting package for TextField and Text widgets.
data.what_it_does: Allows formatting text in Text and TextField widgets using pattern wrappers like bold, italic, strikethrough, underline, and custom patterns. Supports multi-styling substrings and provides custom text editing controllers and context menu builders.
use_when: You need inline markdown-like text formatting within Text widgets.
You want a custom text editing controller that handles formatted text in TextFields.
avoid_when: You need full Markdown rendering with headers, lists, and links.
You require complex rich text document models.
strengths: Includes custom text editing controller and context menu builders.
weaknesses: All formatter patterns must be distinctive.
Requires all TextStyles to be mergeable together.
